low_level: Registers 29 to 127 over the 47 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (0 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 1040 to 65600 bytes, harness 0.10 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068.
Adapter statics: input arrangement packed_rows, output indices, temp storage 1 to 1 bytes, 2 rows per group.

Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 114 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle, 34 phase 3b cells failed only the sorted-order check, which does not apply to unsorted output.
Phase 3b sorted-output check (umbriel-b200-047): 34 cells failed only the order check, not applicable to unsorted output.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): throughput not_guaranteed wins 3 of 7 cells (2 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T16, 1 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T8, runner-up in 1), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 6 cells (2 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T16, 1 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T8, runner-up in 0).
Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 8, bf16 N 128), the median margin over the runner-up is +22 percent and over the scope's reference control +284 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 128 k 4 +85 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T8 in throughput prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 32 k 4 +25 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 32 k 16 +10 percent behind W2_packed_sw_v2@T8 in throughput prefer_smaller_index.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): throughput not_guaranteed wins 1 of 4 cells (runner-up in 3), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 5 cells (1 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T4, 1 as N5_rows_fs_sub@T16, runner-up in 3).
negative: No sorted output by contract (card: sorted_output_support none), every phase 3b cell fails the order check by design and is recorded as not applicable, the unsorted cells stand. Throughput only.
surprises: On GB200 the 16-lane form at N 128 runs lower in throughput than on B200 (bf16 k 16: 604 against 418 Gelem/s), which moves the cell to W2_packed_sw_v2 at 8 lanes, a generation effect confirmed on a second GB200 host.
